name: 大模型评测与基准
status: 草稿：论文、数据集与引文均已用脚本核对；阅读顺序与示范卡待学长学姐核对
goal: 读懂「一个大模型分数是怎么来的、能信几分」：基准怎么出题、怎么判分、数据污染和裁判偏差怎么影响结论。

papers.title: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding
papers.why: 先看「多学科选择题基准」长什么样：后面大多数评测都是它的变体，也最容易看懂怎么算分。

papers.title: C-Eval: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models
papers.why: MMLU 的中文版思路：题目从哪来、怎么分难度，对照着看基准怎么换一种语言。

papers.title: CMMLU: Measuring massive multitask language understanding in Chinese
papers.why: 另一个中文多学科基准；和 C-Eval 并排读，矩阵里会出现第一组可比的格子。

papers.title: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
papers.why: 数学应用题基准：答案能自动判对，适合看「怎么判对」本身会不会出错。

papers.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
papers.why: 开放式回答没法自动判，于是让模型当裁判；读它列出的裁判偏差。

papers.title: Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference
papers.why: 用众包的人类偏好给模型排名；重点读它自己承认的用户和题目偏差。

papers.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
papers.why: 全面评测框架（很长）：只读引言、方法总览和结果摘要，学它怎么同时看多个指标。

papers.title: Time Travel in LLMs: Tracing Data Contamination in Large Language Models
papers.why: 数据污染：在拿不到预训练数据时，怎么判断模型是不是见过测试题。

papers.title: Proving Test Set Contamination in Black Box Language Models
papers.why: 同一个问题的统计检验做法；和上一篇并排，矩阵里「是否查污染」这一列会亮起来。

papers.title: GPQA: A Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A Benchmark
papers.why: 专家出的、搜不到答案的难题；读它为什么只有几百道题，以及这对统计功效意味着什么。

datasets.name: MMLU
datasets.note: 57 个学科的选择题；笔记本就能跑小子集

datasets.name: GSM8K
datasets.note: 小学数学应用题，答案可自动判

datasets.name: MT-Bench（FastChat 里的 llm_judge）
datasets.note: 多轮开放问题 + 模型当裁判

datasets.name: HELM
datasets.note: 评测框架，可直接复用它的指标实现

open_problems.paper: Proving Test Set Contamination in Black Box Language Models
open_problems.quote: we believe it is an exciting open problem to build tests that are capable of reliably detecting contamination at the single-duplication-count regime
open_problems.note: 只重复出现一次的测试题，现有检验抓不到

open_problems.paper: Proving Test Set Contamination in Black Box Language Models
open_problems.quote: the p-values presented in this paper do not have multiple test corrections applied
open_problems.note: 做了很多次检验却没做多重比较校正

open_problems.paper: Proving Test Set Contamination in Black Box Language Models
open_problems.quote: We strongly encourage future dataset creators to apply a random shuffle to their datasets (and to publicize this fact), which would allow our tests to be applied.
open_problems.note: 数据集是否打乱过，决定这类检验能不能用

open_problems.paper: Time Travel in LLMs: Tracing Data Contamination in Large Language Models
open_problems.quote: does not distinguish between different types of contamination
open_problems.note: 能查出污染，但分不清是哪一种污染

open_problems.paper: Time Travel in LLMs: Tracing Data Contamination in Large Language Models
open_problems.quote: we encourage future research that can detect contamination, pinpoint its sources, and identify its various forms
open_problems.note: 污染从哪来、有哪些形式，还没人系统地分清

open_problems.paper: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
open_problems.quote: This paper emphasizes helpfulness but largely neglects safety.
open_problems.note: 模型当裁判只评了有用性，没评安全

open_problems.paper: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
open_problems.quote: there are multiple dimensions like accuracy, relevance, and creativity, but they are all combined into a single metric in this study
open_problems.note: 多个维度被压成一个分数

open_problems.paper: Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference
open_problems.quote: This source might not accurately reflect the real-world usage of LLMs in production environments or specialized domains, potentially leading to a skewed prompt distribution.
open_problems.note: 众包题目不代表真实使用场景

open_problems.paper: C-Eval: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models
open_problems.quote: There are many other abilities such as reasoning over and calling APIs, as well as multiple aspects that extend beyond accuracy, including safety, bias, and robustness.
open_problems.note: 中文基准只看准确率，没看鲁棒性和偏见

open_problems.paper: GPQA: A Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A Benchmark
open_problems.quote: it does not provide a lot of statistical power for accuracy comparisons
open_problems.note: 题目太少，两个模型的差距可能只是噪声

open_problems.quote: as models gain the ability to process multimodal inputs, benchmarks should be designed to reflect this change
open_problems.note: 纯文本基准测不到多模态能力
